column1: # Lesson hints, written for Banana Kana.

column2: A cross with a big loop swinging round it, like someone flailing: "ahh!"
Two short strokes side by side, like a pair of eels: "ee".
A dash over a hook, like a face pulling an "oo" pout.
A dash over a zigzag that ends in a kick: an energetic "eh!"
Like あ, but the loop opens out to the right with a dot: "oh!" with a raised hand.
A strong stroke with a tick beside it, like a karate chop: "ka!"
Two bars over a hook: a key with its teeth sticking out.
One bend, like a beak opening to say "ku".
A tall line next to a crossed hook, like a keg on its stand.
Two short strokes, like a pair of coins stacked: "ko".
One bar and a curve: like き with one bar missing. Say "sa".
A single hook, like a fishing line: "shi" (she) caught a fish.
A bar with a loop dropping through it, like a swing: "su".
A bar crossed by two posts, one bending down: like a seat seen side-on.
A zigzag that runs into a curve, like a sewing thread: "so".
A t on the left with こ beside it: "ta".
A bar with a curve under it, like a 5 drawn backwards: "chi" (cheek).
One wave, like a tsunami rolling in: "tsu".
A bar that drops into a curve, like an arm and hand: "te" means hand.
A short tick above a curve, like a toe with a splinter: "to".
A cross, a dot and a loop: a knot tied at the end: "na".
A tall line next to こ, like a knee beside two steps: "ni".
Like め, but with a little loop at the end: noodles twirled on chopsticks: "nu".
A post with a curl ending in a loop, like a cat's tail: "ne" (neko).
One swirl, like a "no" sign drawn in one go.
Like け, with a loop at the bottom: "ha" - a laugh with a curl.
A wide smile: "hee hee".
Several small marks spread out, like Mt Fuji with clouds: "fu".
A single peak, like a roof or a hill: "he".
Like は with an extra bar on top: a hoe leaning on a post.
Two bars crossed by a post that ends in a loop: "ma" carrying a bag.
A curl with a stroke through its tail, like the number 21: "mi".
A bar, a loop and a dot: a cow going "moo".
Two crossing strokes curling round, like an eye: "me".
A fish hook with two bars across it: catch "more" fish.
A curve, a dot and a long stroke, like a yacht's sail: "ya".
A loop with a line straight through it, like a fish: "yu".
A short bar on a post with a loop at the foot: a yo-yo hanging down.
A dot over a curl, like a rabbit's ear and body: "ra".
Two strokes, the right one longer, like reeds by a river: "ri".
Like ろ, but ending in a loop: a route that goes round again: "ru".
A post with a curling stroke that kicks out at the end: "re".
A zigzag with an open curve, like a road bending: "ro".
A post and a big open curve, like a wave: "wa".
A bar, a zigzag and a hook: someone shouting "whoa!" Read as "o" in sentences.
A single stroke like a lower-case n with a tail: "n".

Like an axe head on a handle: "a".
A slash and a post, like an easel: "i".
A small tick over a box shape: like う, a pouting "oo".
Like a capital I lying on its girders: an "e"-beam.
A cross with a slash, like a person in a big coat: "o".
Like か without its tick: "ka".
Two bars and a post, like a key: "ki".
Two strokes like the edge of a cookie with a bite out: "ku".
Like the letter K leaning: "ke".
Two corners of a box: "ko".
A bar with two posts, one hooked: "sa".
Two dots and an upward stroke, like a smiling face looking right: "shi". Compare ツ.
A bar with a leg kicking out, like someone skiing: "su".
Like せ with straighter lines: "se".
One dot and one long stroke falling down: "so". Compare ン.
Like ク with an extra line inside: "ta".
A short tick, a bar and a long stroke: "chi".
Three strokes falling downwards, like a wave coming in: "tsu". Compare シ.
Two bars and a hanging stroke, like a telegraph pole: "te".
A post with a tick, like a toe: "to".
A cross with a slanted leg: "na".
Two bars, like に without its post: "ni".
A hooked stroke crossed by a short slash: "nu".
A dot on a post with arms, like a necktie: "ne".
One stroke: like a "no" slash.
Two strokes spreading apart, like a laugh: "ha".
A bar and a hooked stroke, like a heel: "hi".
A bar that bends down, like ふ simplified: "fu".
The same peak as へ: "he".
A cross with two little legs, like a holy cross: "ho".
A bar that folds back with a tick, like a mask: "ma".
Three short strokes stacked: "mi".
A triangle with an arm out, like a cow's head: "mu".
Two crossing strokes, like an X marked on a map: "me".
Two bars with a hooked post, like も straightened: "mo".
Like や straightened out: "ya".
A bar with a hooked corner, like a U-bend: "yu".
Three bars joined on the right, like a backwards E: "yo".
A short bar over a hooked stroke: "ra".
Two strokes, the right one longer: "ri", like り.
Two strokes, the right one with a tail: like roots: "ru".
One stroke that kicks up, like a tick: "re".
A square box: "ro". Like ろ squared off.
A box with an open bottom, like a wide mouth: "wa".
Like フ with an extra bar: "wo". Rare in modern Japanese.
One dot and one stroke rising up: "n". Compare ソ.
